notes.title: Cheftastic Pricing Update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]*ANNOUCEMENT Cheftastic FREE* [/b][/h3]

Cheftastic!: Buffet Blast will be going FREE! by approximately the end of November 2024

We want to thank everyone who supported the development of what was originally a student project. 

As the 4 original members move on to new adventures in our lives, we want to make Cheftastic available for all to play so we can share our achievement with all of you


- Please stay tuned for more news on the future of Not A Goose! -

notes.title: Cheftastic 1.0-07
notes.notes:
[b]Updated[/b]

[list]
[*]Added score multiplier to each playable area to improve progression and score balancing (Veggie Fields = 1x, Desert Dunes = 1.5x, Cryo Point = 2x)
[*]Improved consistency of powerups between playthroughs
[*]Minor balance tweaks
[*]Temporarily disabled crash-recovery system to give us more time to update it to the new game framework (This should hopefully be reactivated in the next update)
[/list]


[b]Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Enemies becoming invisible
[*][b]Fixed[/b] inconsistent enemy counts when returning to a previously crashed game
[/list]


[b]Crashes[/b]

If you still experience frequent crashes, try one or more of the following:
[list]
[*]Ensure you are running Cheftastic on a system that meets or exceeds the minimum hardware requirements outlined on the Steam store page
[*]Verify the integrity of the game cache
[*]Check for updated graphics card drivers
[*]Reinstall Cheftastic for a clean install of the latest update
[/list]


[u][b]How you can help us[/b][/u]

We're doing our best to discover and record any bugs you come across. If you find anything that could be fixed, please don't hesitate to reach out to us to let us know.

Join our discord: [url=https://discord.gg/yVgkHTBy]Cheftastic Community Discord[/url]

notes.title: Cheftastic 1.0-06
notes.notes:
[b]Updated[/b]

[list]
[*]Added crash recovery system which will prompt player to continue last played session when reloading the game after a crash - (If you have crashed in a previous version of the game, you may be prompted to continue this playthrough when you first play 1.0-06)
[*]Removed slow rate of fire for early rounds
[*]Leaderboard now supports non-Latin characters
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*]Night mode padlock remaining locked for the first time when entering the hub on a play session, for those who have previously unlocked night mode
[*]Reduced loading times for higher performing systems
[*]Music being restarted when using magnet pickup
[*]Various crash causes
[/list]


[b]Crashes[/b]

If you still experience frequent crashes, try one or more of the following:
[list]
[*]Ensure you are running Cheftastic on a system that meets or exceeds the minimum hardware requirements outlined on the Steam store page
[*]Verify the integrity of the game cache
[*]Check for updated graphics card drivers

[/list]

notes.title: Cheftastic 1.0-05
notes.notes:
[b]Updated[/b]

[list]
[*]New display mode settings allow you to choose between windowed, borderless, and fullscreen modes
[*]Game will now pause for stability when using 'Alt+Tab'
[*]Life pickups now spawn more consistently throughout different playthroughs
[*]Adjusted levels in Desert Dunes that were particularly unforgiving
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*]Level unlock and night mode achievements will now unlock automatically if you have previously unlocked them when loading into the hub for the first time

notes.title: Cheftastic!: Buffet Blast - Live Development Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41144894/8e3621760690ba9fc4dd86cfc83546f9079345b9.png[/img]

After a successful launch of Cheftastic we're looking to the future and moving to a live development cycle which will include game-changing FREE updates for everyone who owns the game. These updates will be released periodically over the next 6-12 months and will feature a wide variety of content to add to your game at no extra cost.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41144894/3a21613faa622019b78746487a7f721bde47263f.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41144894/bd9301861dc1dab44ad2b9a5b53df2d03f3e0fb1.png[/img]

In the summer of 2022 ‘Chef’ will be getting a new drop of weapons and power-ups for you to venture into the battlefield to destroy them pesky vegetables! More information about what you can expect will be coming soon!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41144894/4908e8b848fc1c9ff907098b2ec024063e3b3204.png[/img]


Two further updates are planned in the future in the names of ‘Second Invasion’ and ‘The Kiln’. For now, we’ll leave your creative minds to ponder what these might entail! 

Keep an eye on our social media channels to keep up to date with all the latest information!



[i]Disclaimer:

All future updates are subject to change, remove or replacement and we appreciate any feedback or suggestions you may have for us!
[/i]

notes.title: Cheftastic 1.0-04 (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
[b]Updated[/b]

[list]
[*]Right stick and D-pad can now be used on controller to scroll through full leaderboard
[*]Enemies now spawn further away from the doors so they are no longer visible when they first spawn in
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*]Hub leaderboard panels not centering around player score
[*]Night mode switch appearing locked when returning to the hub for the first time
[*]Several achievements not activating when complete
[*]Level unlock achievements activating before unlocking their respective levels
[*]Characters getting stuck on top of blenders
[/list]

[b]We are aware of a CTD (Crash To Desktop) affecting some players[/b] and will be investigating this over the next week.


[u][b]How you can help us[/b][/u]

We're doing our best to discover and record any bugs you come across. If you find anything that could be fixed, please don't hesitate to reach out to us to let us know.

Join our discord: [url=https://discord.gg/yVgkHTBy]Cheftastic Community Discord[/url]
